repos.name: InvokeAI
repos.note: openapi-checks.yml regenerates the schema from FastAPI and diffs it. Only invokeai/app is scanned; frontend and other packages are excluded.

repos.name: NodeBB
repos.note: test/api/routes.js:24-86 compares mounted Express routes against both committed contracts, with explicit exclusions at lines 62-81. Together they cover the forum read and write APIs; UI, federation and plugin routes remain in scope as undocumented routes. The real /api/v3 mount is retained. install/web.js:63-68 starts a separate setup server and is excluded.

repos.name: answer
repos.note: Makefile generate runs go generate; swag annotations live on the handlers for this Gin service. Known stale annotations: personal question page lacks its service prefix; activation uses plural users instead of user; notification config documents POST instead of GET.

repos.name: auth
repos.note: Maintained beside internal/api; the hosted prefix is declared at openapi.yaml:38 and absent from the root-local router (api.go:219-222,498,520). Reauthenticate has a stale documented verb.

repos.name: dvws-node
repos.note: scripts/generate-openapi.js generates this contract with swagger-autogen from src/routes; test/openapi.test.js checks the document.

repos.name: eShop
repos.note: Catalog.API.csproj exports OpenAPI during build with Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server. Both API versions are included; query-parameter version distinctions are outside endpoint scoring. Only Catalog.API source is scanned, not other services or shared default endpoints.

repos.name: flowable-engine
repos.note: Hand-written process-service controllers. docs/public-api/references/swagger/README.md:7-13 identifies the stable contract as generated from source annotations with manual corrections; docs/public-api/tools/flowable-oas-generator/pom.xml:51-84 selects this package. The application deployment prefix is declared by modules/flowable-app-rest/src/main/resources/flowable-default.properties:2,43; the scoped controller library registers local paths.

repos.name: gotify
repos.note: Makefile:41-50 regenerates docs/spec.json from source annotations and fails on a diff. Covers this notification service, including users, clients, applications, messages and plugins; UI and optional transport routes remain in scope. No prefix adjustment. plugin/example/echo/echo.go:74-77 defines an example plugin webhook, not a core service registration, and is excluded.

repos.name: immich
repos.note: Generated from server controllers by the OpenAPI tooling; .github/workflows/check-openapi.yml checks contract changes. Only server is scanned.

repos.name: langflow
repos.note: docs/openapi/generate_openapi.py:83-93 writes create_app().openapi(); lines 96-103 select this committed document. Pinned to the schema-generator introduction, before workflow routes moved into the separate lfx package, so src/backend/base contains all service routers (langflow/main.py:532-534). Component examples, frontend and tests are outside scope. No prefix adjustment.

repos.name: listmonk
repos.note: .github/workflows/github-pages.yml renders Swagger UI from this hand-maintained collection. cmd/handlers.go registers both the mailing-list API and subscriber-facing pages. Keep its literal /api prefix. The collection omits GET /api/subscribers/:id/activity and the user-management endpoints.

repos.name: meshery
repos.note: The Meshery Server contract is bundled from API definitions maintained in meshery/schemas. The contributing-schemas guide describes the OSS bundle. server/router/server.go registers the Gorilla mux routes, including /api/registry and its deprecated /api/meshmodels alias through registerRegistryRoute. The contract includes controller status subscriptions but omits GET /api/system/events/subscribe and the /api/user/prefs routes.

repos.name: owncast
repos.note: Makefile api-generate produces the checked-in chi server from this spec; /api is a real mount, not a prefix to strip.

repos.name: podinfo
repos.note: Makefile swagger regenerates this document from handler annotations; runtime path helpers remain part of the analyzer task. token/validate is annotated POST although registered GET.

repos.name: pokeapi
repos.note: Makefile openapi-generate uses Django spectacular; describes the REST API, not the separate GraphQL service.

repos.name: pretalx
repos.note: justfile:125-128 regenerates this committed schema through Django spectacular; src/pretalx/common/management/commands/spectacular.py:9-16 delegates to drf-spectacular. Covers the complete REST API (src/pretalx/urls.py:42 and api/urls.py); the scoped application also contains organiser, agenda and submission UI routes, which remain visible as code-only rows. No prefix adjustment.

repos.name: vikunja
repos.note: magefile.go Generate.SwaggerDocs runs swag; release automation regenerates and commits pkg/swagger. Only pkg is scanned; standalone example plugins and the frontend are outside this service scope. Known stale annotations: singular image instead of images in the Unsplash proxy; PUT rather than POST for label updates.
